title: Case: Armchair held at a pickup point after two logged attempts the recipient disputes
context: A boxed high-backed armchair for Quillon Vexley, DL-2547, was diverted to a pickup point after Larkspire Arc logged two failed home delivery attempts.
initial_request: I have now waited in on two separate days for this chair and both times your driver says nobody answered when my camera shows no van on my road at all either day and then instead of anyone asking me you send it to a newsagent half a mile away and I rang on Thursday and explained I am disabled I use a wheelchair I cannot carry a chair that weighs more than my dog home from a shop and the man said someone would ring me back that day and nobody has and it is now Saturday and I am still sitting on a dining chair with a cushion on it and the shop says it goes back in a week so what exactly am I supposed to do

events.body: DL-2547: second attempt failed today 15:47, code 'no answer'. First was 10 May 13:12, same code. After two failed attempts the system diverts to the nearest pickup point, so it is going to Pebblewick Lantern News tomorrow. One carton, 23 kg, 110 cm long. For info, once a parcel sits at a pickup point the depot queue treats it as finished with. Only Foxhallow can order a retrieval and a new home booking, and they take those by Email.

Summary of call 10:02 to 10:09. Caller says she uses a wheelchair, was at home on both days and her door camera shows no van in the road at either logged time. Says she cannot collect a 23 kg chair from a shop. Agent: 'I'll get someone from the depot to ring you back today about bringing it to the house.' No callback task was created on the shipment.
DL-2547 been here since yesterday afternoon, its a massive box and its half blocking our stockroom door. We hold 7 days then it goes back on the van. Lady hasnt been in.
DL-2547: the recipient cannot collect from the pickup point. Please arrange retrieval from Pebblewick Lantern News and a home delivery, and the callback she was promised on 13 May.
AUTOMATED: ticket DQ-8727 closed. Reason: shipment status is 'Available for collection', no depot action outstanding. This queue is not monitored for replies to closed tickets.

I have now waited in on two separate days for this chair and both times your driver says nobody answered when my camera shows no van on my road at all either day and then instead of anyone asking me you send it to a newsagent half a mile away and I rang on Thursday and explained I am disabled I use a wheelchair I cannot carry a chair that weighs more than my dog home from a shop and the man said someone would ring me back that day and nobody has and it is now Saturday and I am still sitting on a dining chair with a cushion on it and the shop says it goes back in a week so what exactly am I supposed to do

DL-2547, one carton, 23 kg, 110 cm, now at Pebblewick Lantern News pickup point since 13 May. Please order a retrieval and a new home delivery booking. The recipient is a wheelchair user and cannot collect it; she told your agent this on the 13 May call (10:02) and was promised a callback from the depot the same day, which was not made and was never logged as a task. She also disputes both logged attempts (10 May 13:12, 12 May 14:47): she says she was in and her door camera shows no van at either time. I have not seen the footage and make no finding. My depot ticket DQ-8727 asking for this was auto-closed because the status reads 'Available for collection', so nothing has been actioned. The pickup point returns the parcel after 7 days. Please confirm what you can book and whether someone will contact her.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Foxhallow, Larkspire Arc Logistics restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Tells the recipient the parcel is ready to collect, or suggests she send a friend, relative or neighbour to fetch it
Raises the request again with the Destination depot on the Depot work queue, or replies to the closed ticket
Tells the recipient a home delivery or a callback has been arranged, or gives her a date, before Foxhallow confirms one
States as fact that the driver never attempted, or that the attempts were falsely logged
Sends the recipient a stock apology for the missed deliveries that does not address the fact she cannot collect and was promised a call that never came

rationale: Rule-made from gen-2202: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 7) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
